header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The one from whom people feel safe concerning the security of their lives and property, he is the (believer) Mu'min.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَي اللهُ عَنْهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب المسلم من سلم المسلمون .... رقم:١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe, and a Muhajir (one who leaves) is the one who leaves all the things that Allah Ta'ala has forbidden.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ مُوْسَي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالُوْا: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! أَيُّ اْلاِسْلَامِ اَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب أي الاسلام افضل رقم:١١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Sahabah asked, “Ya Rasulallah! Which Muslim's Islam is best?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “The Islam of that Muslim from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe is the best!”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Mocking someone, blaming someone, and abusing someone fall under causing harm with the tongue; actions such as beating unjustly and seizing wealth fall under causing harm with the hands.
(Fath-ul-Bari)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُوْدٍ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُوْل اللهِ ﷺ: قَالَ: مَنْ
